prose.subject: Urgent: Payment Details Update for Invoice INV-70613
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

I hope you’re having a good week. I’m reaching out because our finance team has switched to a new treasury provider to streamline our settlement cycles for USDC payments. This change is effective immediately for all pending invoices.

Could you please ensure that invoice INV-70613, totaling 1786.07 USDC, is paid to our updated NEAR payout account: pay-juniperfreight82.testnet

Since we are on a tight timeline for our next supplier batch, could you prioritize this transfer today? If it’s already in progress with the old address, please let me know right away so we can arrange a swift swap on our end to avoid double-processing fees.

I’ve attached the updated W-9 and bank confirmation letter for your records. Please feel free to call me directly at extension 402 if you have any questions, though I’d prefer we keep the email thread as our primary record for audit purposes.

Thanks for your quick help with this.

Best,

Tomas Adeyemi
Senior Accounts Manager
Juniper Freight
